name: Armor Class: Normal, Touch, Flat-Footed and condition adjustments
description: The attack chooses normal or Touch AC. Target states independently alter eligible AC contributions, including Flat-Footed and Helpless. An attack can target Touch AC against a Flat-Footed or Helpless creature.

contributions.other: Additional legitimate typed or untyped AC contributions remain effective unless the incoming attack or an effect expressly removes them.
contributions.dexterity: Use the applicable effective Dexterity modifier after armor caps and feature exceptions. A negative modifier is a penalty and persists when a positive Dexterity bonus is denied.
contributions.dodge: Dodge contributions are unavailable whenever applicable Dexterity defenses are denied, unless a specific rule explicitly overrides this.

suppress-contributions.application: Remove each targeted contribution at most once per incoming attack; suppress only positive Dexterity bonuses, not Dexterity penalties. Remove dodge bonuses while Dexterity defense is denied.

set-effective-ability-score.application: Replace the defender's effective Dexterity modifier for AC with the modifier implied by the specified score, including negative values. Do not also apply positive-Dexterity suppression as an additional numerical penalty.

add-modifier.application: Apply the value to the effective AC only when its attack-relative predicate is true. Identical nonStackingGroup effects from related conditions contribute only once, at the most severe penalty or bonus.

stacking: Resolve the attack's requested defense category first; a condition never changes ordinary targeting into Touch targeting.
Apply the defense's included contributions, then the attack-relative status restrictions. The resulting effective AC is calculated for each incoming attack.
Repeated loss of Dexterity or dodge bonuses from multiple conditions is not cumulative.
When Helpless sets Dexterity to 0, use its effective AC Dexterity modifier (-5) rather than first removing positive Dexterity and then subtracting another 5.

An effect's source-scoped attack roll Advantage is separate from defender-side AC impairment when independently granted. Do not retain an attack Advantage from a condition that has been reconciled into an equivalent defender-side AC effect.
Prone and Helpless both supply melee exposure penalties in a common nonStackingGroup; use -4 once rather than -8 when both apply.
Defender-specific exceptions such as Uncanny Dodge or source-granted ability to retain an AC component are evaluated before finalizing the suppressed components, to the exact extent granted.
No implicit negative/positive Dexterity conversion, source edition toggle, hidden attack bonus or unlisted AC component is permitted.
excludedOrDeferred: Imported 3.x +2 attack bonus while Invisible is not added on top of denial of Dexterity defense; detailed attack accuracy balancing remains a separate review.
Deafened's 3.x initiative and verbal spellcasting penalties are deferred to initiative/spellcasting reconciliation.
Mandatory flight under 3.x Frightened is deferred to the fear-condition family.
Coup de grace is a separate advanced combat procedure, not an automatic side effect of Helpless.
Full source-specific touch attack and Flat-Footed exceptions beyond the approved shared semantics require explicit feature grants.
No runtime code is implemented in this data-only baseline.
